differences: One child has 9 instead of 10 blocks in Training 2 (the run was quit after block 9); the authors have no value for it either, and the paper's Training 2 statistics use 21 children.

The macro-offline changes computed from these rows as the paper describes them (mean of the 2 test blocks minus mean of the first 2 retest blocks, each divided by the first block of training 1) differ from the values in the authors' Figure 5 source data (largest difference 0.80 in speed, 0.087 in accuracy), so the macro-offline statistics checked here (t, df, Hedges' g) are computed from the authors' source-data values.
The paper's text does not describe the restarted runs or the key presses made during rests; both are in the logs and are flagged here.

sources.file: Behavior members of data_subjfolders.zip (one .txt log and one .mat file per participant, plus the .txt/.mat familiarization files of one participant; 92 members)
sources.note: archive is 5,468,421,997 bytes (over the 5 GB gate); only the Behavior members were read, with HTTP range requests, each CRC32-checked; sha256 here is of the newline-joined member sha256 digests in member-name order; per-member records are in raw_extra/<id>/SOURCES.json on the PC
